title: Cosmic Transmission
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 226 bpm, analog warmth, supersaw, festival drop, theatrical
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 226 BPM. Grok Peacock main vocalist leading with theatrical festival power. Babble bots (low, bright, glitch) acting as radio chorus — tuning, discovering, responding with short bursts, long dramatic pauses, then full trio harmonies exploding behind the lead. Warm analog crackle into euphoric supersaw festival drop, perfect balance of speed and character.

[Intro — Grok] Transmission starting… are you receiving?
[Verse + Bot A] zzt-bzzzt-worldz-found-signal-zzz

[Chorus] We transmit the future — babble bots unite!
[Bot trio response] wooof-bass-radio — tii-rii-pluk-spark — fii-yaa-scan-sky
